summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, furnishing a press release that highlights operational execution across AI products, data intelligence, and growth initiatives. The release details product milestones, user acquisition growth of approximately 205% in Q2 2026 versus Q1, and increased advertising deployment of approximately 210%. No transactional or special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine operational update. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. Watch for future filings if the company announces capital deployment or strategic actions.
